summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Supplier Election & Voting System. All 13 requested features verified successfully. Backend APIs (19/19 pytest tests passed) and Frontend UI (all flows working via Playwright).

POST_elections_create.evidence: API returns election with correct status based on dates

GET_elections_list.description: Returns elections with status and counts
GET_elections_list.evidence: Returns list with candidates_count, votes_count, and computed status

GET_lookup_supplier.description: Returns supplier data if found by code
GET_lookup_supplier.evidence: Code 2015 returns {found: true, supplier: {name, national_id, center_name, milk_type}}

POST_register_candidate.description: Registers supplier as candidate during nomination
POST_register_candidate.evidence: Successfully registers candidate with all fields

POST_vote.evidence: Vote endpoint works when voting period is open

GET_election_results.evidence: Returns candidates with votes_count and total_votes

voting_period_validation.description: Backend rejects voting when period not open

admin_page_elections_list.description: Admin page /supplier-elections shows elections list and create dialog
admin_page_elections_list.evidence: Page shows election cards with create button, dialog has all fields

supplier_nomination_form.description: Supplier page /supplier-voting shows nomination form with code lookup
supplier_nomination_form.evidence: Lookup auto-fills name, national_id, center_name, milk_type

supplier_candidates_list.description: Supplier page shows candidates list after registration
supplier_candidates_list.evidence: Candidates displayed with name, code, center info

seed_data_creation: Created test election with voting period open for testing, then cleaned up. Existing election 'انتخاب رئيس الموردين 2026' has 2 candidates (codes 2015, 2022).
